checks: API settings clearly distinguishes bundled ODsay and server Gemini; configuring a device Gemini key routes validated condition-only requests through the native bridge with no key or coordinates in the JS payload.
Anonymous candidate comparison uses the existing validators; extra coordinate fields are rejected before Google, quota and malformed responses fail honestly without an automatic paid server retry.
Saved native-state mock survives page restart; Gemini deletion returns to server mode, disabled ODsay can restore the embedded default, and the settings dialog fits small/landscape screens.
The menu back button has a rounded 44-pixel touch target beside the title at three viewport sizes in both themes; tap and keyboard activation return focus to API settings in the menu.
